I formed suspicion after credits of Rs.1.1L, Rs.1.4L and Rs.0.95L (total Rs.3.45L) from unidentified UPI handles A, B and D. Within days, debits of Rs.2.465L and Rs.0.942L went to UPI handle C, which is I4C-flagged: 98.8% of the credits left the account. The customer is a data entry operator with a declared income of Rs.28K per month, so the credits are about 12 times that income, and none of the counterparties is documented.
